lesson_text: Consensus 3F RankCombo (C19 Composite Earnings ICIR 0.575 + C13 Revision Breadth 0.412 + C10 SUE Persistence 0.389) delivers SR 1.076 / CAGR 24.1% with robust OOS retention 0.74, but MDD 49.9% triggers hard fail. The EW percentile rank approach is PIT-clean and structurally simple, but the consensus family (5 consecutive failures) lacks tail risk management. High CAGR suggests genuine alpha; needs DD overlay in S5 to cap MDD < 45%.
core_reference: Jegadeesh & Titman (1993) momentum persistence; DeBondt & Thaler (1985) earnings revision breadth; Bernard & Thomas (1989) SUE persistence. Factor DB ICIR rankings as alpha source.
